title: Candidate submission
description: A mechanism proposed for evaluation (by the enumerator, an agent, a reviewer-driven revision or a person), plus the metadata the evaluator and reviewers need: how model species map to measured channels, what supports each element, and what the proposer assumed. The mechanism itself is the native mechanism.schema.json object; nothing here changes how it is simulated.

name.description: Proposer's short label. Not an identity: the store assigns candidate ids from the canonical chemistry.

parent.description: Candidate id this submission revises (new version of that candidate).

observation_map.description: Measured channel id -> model species whose sum is that channel (mM-N). Default: identity for every channel that has a same-named model species. Use it to lump, e.g. {"NH3": ["NH3", "NH2OH"]} if the assay cannot separate them.

support.description: One entry per reaction, species or rate-law choice that needs justification.

target.description: Reaction id (R1), species (species:X), or a rate-law element (R1.time_modulation).

basis.description: literature: a cited source states it. data: motivated by a specific feature of the evidence. speculative: neither.

source.description: literature: DOI or citation plus location (figure, table, section). data: evidence reference such as dataset id and field.

predictions.description: Statements fixed before evaluation (stored with a timestamp before any fit is run).
